common_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, evolved game boss character variant.
The attached image is Mina dragon candidate C, the user-selected identity baseline. Draw her UNMISTAKABLE POWER-UP EVOLUTION during a boss battle, as a new second-form design. This is not just a changed pose or color swap. The emotional target is: she transformed in the middle of the fight and the player thinks 'she looks much stronger now; can I really win?' Retain her identity, but visibly change the major silhouette and structure to communicate a higher battle stage.
INVARIANTS: SAME Mina face, clearly readable blue anime eyes, recognizable muzzle and head size, charcoal-black / deep navy / ivory / blue palette, blue diamond chest core. Same fine colored linework, soft cel shading and game-sprite stylization as C. Do not drift into photorealism or add dense tiny scale textures. Her expression changes from merely reserved to quietly formidable resolve: steady intense eyes, confident composed mouth, not cute, not smiling, not a generic evil roaring beast. Head must remain readable, not shrunk. Keep torso and head at comparable scale to C rather than making an unrelated giant creature.
BIPEDAL DRAGON ANATOMY remains mandatory: erect chest, a waist, pelvis above TWO legs, TWO independent arms ending in articulated dragon HANDS with palms and fingers. Arms cannot look like front paws. A separate pair of strong wings grows from her back. She is airborne with knees bent below her pelvis and never a horizontal four-legged beast, never a wyvern, never insect-like. No extra limbs or extra wing pairs. Wings are forcefully beating with bent wing elbows and membrane tension, not passively floating. Keep the compact curved tail and readable full-body silhouette.
EVOLUTION LANGUAGE: Give the wings a newly expanded, powerful outline, reshape the existing horns into a stronger distinctive swept-back crest, organize the existing shoulder and chest scales into a few larger clean protective plates. This is her own body transforming, not metal equipment being worn. Sharper organized silhouette, powerful shoulder span and controlled posture. Mina's restrained dignity, blue eyes, and black/white wing motifs remain unmistakable. Do not paste human hair, maid clothing or a headband onto the dragon. Preserve the heroine's melancholy character, not a grinning villain.
PRESENTATION: Single full-body boss sprite, front-three-quarter facing left, slightly low viewing angle to emphasize presence while keeping game readability. Show the evolved design, not a before/after panel. All wing tips, claws, tail and horns inside the canvas with 8% clear margin. Modest body size, broad wings taking the surrounding space; no horizon or size-comparison scenery. Transparent-alpha background. No background gradient, no detached aura, no energy rings, no particle cloud, no attack projectiles, no floor, no text or lettering. Any power light must stay ON the wing markings or chest core so it is not mistaken for enemy bullets.

candidates.name: black_wing_release
candidates.variant_prompt: EVOLUTION E1 - BLACK WING RELEASE. Emphasize formidable silhouette and a confident, powerful wingbeat. Enlarge and sharpen the upper outer sections of C's two wings into broad black/navy sickle-like leading edges with clear shoulder strength, not extra wings. Keep the ivory wing undersides and blue accents, framed by a heavier continuous black outline and elegant pointed trailing lobes. Extend the existing swept-back pale horns into a clean crown-like pair, not a forest of spikes. A few stronger navy shoulder and forearm plates, an enlarged but restrained blue chest gem, and more decisive claw-hand shapes express evolution. Pose: she lifts through a forceful asymmetrical downstroke, chest high, one hand calmly opened toward the player, the other held near her core; two bent legs directly under her pelvis. She has regained control and now looks dangerous. Do not obscure her face with wings. This option uses little glow: the threat comes from shape and posture.

candidates.name: ivory_sigils_awaken
candidates.variant_prompt: EVOLUTION E2 - IVORY WING AWAKENING. Strongest Mina identity in the wings. Broaden both dragon wing membranes into a dramatic dark arch behind her, with large newly opened IVORY fan-like panels separated by deep navy structural ribs, a scalloped-but-sharp repeated rim and a few thin blue inlaid paths. The pattern recalls the ordered white pleats of Mina's original maid silhouette, but is natural wing patterning, absolutely not attached clothes or real frills. Horns form a restrained pale crest echoing that wing rhythm. Add a distinct clean ivory shield-like chest plate surrounding the sapphire core and slightly stronger shoulder plates, still organic dragon scales. She is forcefully lifting both wings into an asymmetric high stroke, head lowered a touch and eyes looking steadily at the opponent, arms visibly independent with one hand extended and one gathering near the chest. Strong transformation reveal and intimidating protective wings, not cute butterfly form; two wings only, visibly jointed bat/dragon supports.

candidates.name: blue_core_unsealed
candidates.variant_prompt: EVOLUTION E3 - BLUE CORE UNSEALED. C has released sealed power: the small chest jewel has become a prominent luminous sapphire diamond core held by newly opened ivory/navy scale plates. A few broad coherent blue light channels spread from the core along the chest and into the two black/navy wing support bones and large ivory membrane markings. Limit light to these anatomical surfaces; no free-floating effects or bullets. Wing membranes are newly stretched wide and taut, with long clean tips and a stronger organic armored shoulder silhouette. Existing horns sweep back more decisively, their pale edges catching the same blue core light. Pose is a powerful banking wingbeat with nearer wing down and far wing raised, torso still clearly upright and bipedal, knees flexed below pelvis, hands open as if bracing a tremendous inner force. Preserve Mina's calm sorrowful eyes but make them focused and radiant. This is an unmistakably advanced battle form, threatening through stored power rather than anger. Keep dark main body and the white wing motif; no neon rainbow or purple aura.
